description: This file is a PHP script for verifying and fixing database health in the vtiger CRM system. It performs database connection, health checks, and renders an HTML report for database table engine and charset issues.

classes.name: DBHealthCheck
classes.description: A class responsible for checking and fixing database table health, including engine type and charset.

methods.name: correctTableEngineType
methods.description: JavaScript function to set the engine type for a specific table and submit the form.
